full_details: The morning was the lodging. At the Theatre you waited in the passage and did not go into the yard. Two Gents wanted no dukes of yours. The share was thirty-six shillings. Pope's Gaunt drew no laugh, the Inns filled three galleries, and Heminges would not say the boxes were better without you. Your line had reached Aldermanbury. Heminges and Bryan will wait on my lord's people at Somerset House within the week. They named no man. The sun was down before five. There is no inn-yard this winter, the Mayor having seen to that, and the Theatre will be played cold. You came home at the entry's hour to a hall candle she had already lit at five. It is the firing sixpence. You ate broth, read nothing, and left the thirty-six unspent. Shoreditch mud was on the hem of the cloak. The jaw is still tender. You did not call it quiet. You marked St Luke at evening prayer and did not open a book. After church you were in bed before the Bow bell, with the cat on your feet.
one_sentence: You walked up for the reckoning, brought thirty-six shillings home, and went to bed with the cat on your feet.
title: Thirty-six shillings, and the hem
